Ticket:
Inquiry regarding pharmacy medication substitution and out-of-stock alert procedures

To Whom It May Concern, our clinical staff requires clarification regarding the proper handling of out-of-stock prescription alerts and the subsequent routing of alternative therapeutic agents to pharmacies. Could you please outline the standard procedure for managing these substitution requests within our platform? Thank you for your assistance.
